newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Power failure halts trading at Karachi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Power failure halts trading at Karachi bourse.

text.p: Floor brokers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) on Monday refused to enter the trading hall in protest at continued power cuts, dealers said.

"Trading is suspended at the exchange because all the agents have refused to enter the ring to protest against the power breakdown at the exchange," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan of BMA Capital Management said. "This is the third session in a row that the Karachi Stock Exchange is without power supply."
A KSE spokesman said trading could not begin without the brokers. "All the agents are standing in the parking lot," he said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
